'''Chidinka''' were a type of reed [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]]. The [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonaks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Kirdo III, hollowed out the reeds of chidinka plants to make [[chidinkalu]], a type of musical instrument. [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]], a Kitonak [[Musician/Legends|musician]] in the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], played a chidinkalu made from chidinka reed.
